common.validity: SIM clock mode: the times of the executor, the bridge wrapper and the checks are SIM times, so an RTF below 1 does not make a run invalid (acceptance amendment 61). The RTF of every judged step is reported. A judged step with a 5 s window RTF below 0.5 is a host failure: recorded, not judged, and run once more on a fresh stack; twice is reported as not judged
common.host: the host-load check of STACK_OPERATIONS_KO.md section 2 is recorded before each session (waiting at most 60 s); the Windows per-process sampler (1 s: total CPU from GetSystemTimes, the sampler lateness, the top processes) runs through every session; docker stats every 15 s; the stall probe is not run
common.host_quiet: the user's stack is stopped (parts A, B) and the heavy-measurement lock is held during every session; right before every judged run (A: after the 120 s settle, before the follow check; B: after the settle, before the browser script; F: before every sim_auto.py start) the sampler's last 30 s must have a mean Windows total CPU below 45 % and a mean load of the efficiency class 0 (E cores) below 50 %, checked every 5 s for at most 900 s; the wait and the means are recorded; after 900 s the run starts anyway and the record says so
common.host_fault: a failed run (A, F) or a failed session (B) is recorded as a host fault (void, not counted) only if the sampler has, in the 5 s before its failure event, a sample with the Windows total CPU at or above 70 %, or a sample that came 1.0 s or more after its due time (interval >= 1 s + 1.0 s), or a mean load of the efficiency class 0 (E cores) at or above 75 % over its samples. Failure event: A and F, the wall time of the first executor tick after the go whose state is not ACTIVE when the run did not end at the row end; B, the wall time of the first executor tick after a go whose state is not ACTIVE and whose reason is not operator_stop / operator_link_lost / hold_released (the script's own STOP and hidden tab), else the wall time of the first failed check of a registered item. A run that ends at the row end but fails a criterion is a failure (no host-fault test). The executor wall time is put on the Windows clock with the offset measured at the session. A void slot is run again at most 2 times on a fresh stack (A, B) or as one more sim_auto.py start and reset on the same stack (F), after the pre-check; every attempt, void or not, is recorded and kept; a slot void three times is not judged (reported as not judged, never as a pass). Failures without a host fault count as failures. The RTF rule (5 s window RTF below 0.5) stays
common.dashboard_port: parts A and B: 127.0.0.1:18091 (a compose override file of the record folder with ports !override); part F: 127.0.0.1:18090 as the user's command

affinity.process: vmmemWSL (or vmmem when that is the name of the WSL VM process)
affinity.how: record the original affinity, set the P-core mask, read it back; restore the original after the job and read it back

schedpolicy.when: the affinity is refused (protected process, access denied) or does not take effect
schedpolicy.scheme: SCHEME_CURRENT (no scheme created, imported or deleted)
schedpolicy.how: record the original AC indices, set both, powercfg /setactive SCHEME_CURRENT, read back; restore both, setactive SCHEME_CURRENT, read back

host_placement.span: from before the job sampler starts until the end of part F; restored in a finally block (also on failure)
host_placement.not_changed: no .wslconfig edit, no WSL restart, no reboot, no other host setting
host_placement.effect_check: recorded, not a criterion: the mean efficiency class 0 and class 1 loads of the sampler over every judged run and the moments of the class 0 at or above 78 %, next to the stage 7 numbers
host_placement.if_no_method: if neither method can be applied the stage 8b sessions are not run (they would repeat stage 7) and the record says so

evidence.stage7_failures_e_class_pct: 79-80 in the 0-2 s before each of the 6 failure events

A.check: steering.exec_checks follow --run <name> --out /runs/follow (one_press: Start, Arm, heartbeats, one go); the check first waits until its own /clock has run 10 s without a wall gap above 0.1 s (at most 60 s) and records it (discovery_settle)
A.passed: every judged run passes every criterion of steer_follow_gsim_v1 and at least three of four slots are judged
A.recorded: per run: the host-quiet pre-check (wait, means), the sampler over the run (mean, p90, max, the largest lateness, the top processes of the highest samples), the executor scan processing p50/p99/max (proc_ms of the ACTIVE ticks), the executor loop p50/p99/max and skipped ticks, the ESP emulator clock_stalls, discovery_settle (A), the failure event and the host-fault test (failed runs)
A.cause_rule: decided before the runs, reported with the verdict (the verdict stays as recorded): a failing run whose failure event comes within 1.0 s after the end of an ESP emulator /clock stall above 0.25 s (monotonic time; the executor input diagnostics are off by default, so the emulator record alone) is put on the SIM side (DDS delivery of the stack); any other failing run is put on the executor or the controller; the host-fault test is reported apart

B.check: the SIM dashboard in Chrome on 127.0.0.1:18091, phases auto, stop, restart of the stage 4 script (each check with its wall time), plus the page's own session digests (page_sessions; not judged)

items.name: prepare
items.rule: the auto panel offers 준비; pressing it (and Arm if offered) reaches 자율 주행 시작 within 16 s

items.name: one_press_running
items.rule: one press -> 주행 중 within 10 s and the vehicle moves (emulator speed > 0.05 m/s)

items.name: heartbeat
items.rule: largest gap of the last 20 heartbeats while visible < 0.50 s

items.name: tab_hidden_link_lost
items.rule: tab hidden -> run_state paused, stop_reason OPERATOR_LINK_LOST 2.0 s after hiding, no heartbeat after hiding, the vehicle below 0.05 m/s 4 s after hiding, visible again -> 다시 출발 and still paused

items.name: screen_stop_while_running
items.rule: a new run, one press, about 6 s of driving (> 0.05 m/s), the status-bar STOP -> stop_detail operator_stop (OPERATOR_OR_BACKSTOP), below 0.05 m/s 3 s later and 6 s later

items.name: restart_after_stop
items.rule: after that STOP: latch acknowledged, a new run prepared, one press -> the vehicle drives again (> 0.05 m/s within 6 s), the STOP stops it again (operator_stop, below 0.05 m/s 3 s later)

B.recorded: the executor's operator_link events (bind, takeover, release, conflict; session digests) and the page session digests: a session of another client that bound during the session is reported

F.check: the user's local commands as they are (the local tool folder tools/local_env outside the repository): python -B sim_stack.py start --no-browser (image wf11, SIM clock by default), 150 s, then 3 times: python -B sim_auto.py start; python -B sim_auto.py reset; 20 s
F.criteria: each run ends at the row end: the executor's run_end of that run has end_reason row_end (the screen line of sim_auto shows the end); distance and duration are reported
F.passed: 3 of 3 runs end at the row end
F.camera: not taken (the README animation of stage 4 stays)
F.note: sim_stack.py starts its DEFAULT_IMAGE ubts-steer-sim:wf11 (local tool outside the repository) with the compose file of the branch main; sim_auto.py sends its go also when a heartbeat was refused (revision 5)
F.recorded: per run: the host-quiet pre-check (wait, means), the sampler over the run (mean, p90, max, the largest lateness, the top processes of the highest samples), the executor scan processing p50/p99/max (proc_ms of the ACTIVE ticks), the executor loop p50/p99/max and skipped ticks, the ESP emulator clock_stalls, discovery_settle (A), the failure event and the host-fault test (failed runs)

repeat: a failing part may be run once more after a fix on the SIM or executor side that does not loosen a safety limit, written first as an amendment (section 8) and committed; both attempts are reported. Host-fault reruns are not repeats
